blogPosts.title: How to Maintain Plasterwork in Coastal Areas like Frankston South
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn essential tips for maintaining plasterwork in Frankston South's coastal climate, preventing common issues like cracks and moisture damage.
body: Living in Frankston South, a coastal suburb, means your plasterwork faces unique challenges from salt air, humidity, and temperature fluctuations. Regular maintenance is key to preserving the integrity and appearance of your plaster. Start by inspecting surfaces annually for signs of cracks, stains, or mould, especially around windows and external corners where exposure is highest.

To prevent moisture damage, ensure proper ventilation in rooms with plaster finishes. In Frankston South, where humidity can spike, use exhaust fans in bathrooms and kitchens to reduce condensation. Apply sealants or moisture-resistant coatings on external plaster to protect against salt spray, which can cause deterioration over time.

Address minor cracks promptly to avoid them spreading. Use flexible fillers suitable for Frankston South's climate, as rigid compounds may crack with thermal movement. For cornice and casing bead maintenance, dust regularly and repaint every few years to maintain a fresh look. Services in Frankston South offers maintenance packages to keep your plaster in top condition.

For tearaways and brickwork transitions, check for gaps or separation, which can occur due to settling. Reapply sealant if needed to maintain a tight seal. Window reveals should be inspected for peeling paint or plaster erosion, and touched up as necessary. In coastal areas, using marine-grade materials can enhance longevity.

Professional cleaning is recommended for stubborn stains—avoid abrasive tools that could damage the plaster surface. Instead, use mild detergents and soft cloths. Services provides expert cleaning and restoration services in Frankston South, ensuring your plasterwork remains immaculate despite the harsh coastal environment.

By following these maintenance tips, you can extend the life of your plasterwork in Frankston South, protecting your investment and keeping your home looking beautiful. Regular care not only prevents costly repairs but also maintains the property's value in this desirable suburb.
